title: Context Fabric — shared definitions
description: Reusable $defs shared by every Context Fabric v1 entity schema. This file defines no root document type.

Id.description: Opaque stable identifier. UUIDv7 recommended so ids sort roughly by creation time. Identity is ONLY carried by this field — never by labels, refs, or paths.

SchemaVersion.description: Version of the Context Fabric schema the payload conforms to (semver). Major version also appears in the schema $id path (/v1/).

Slug.description: URL-safe lowercase identifier segment, unique within its parent scope.

Code.description: Stable canonical code used for reference resolution (e.g. USFM book code 'JHN'). Language-independent; never a display label.

NamespacedType.description: Open node/annotation type: '<namespace>:<name>' (e.g. 'bible:verse', 'quran:ayah', 'tei:div', 'generic:paragraph'). Namespaces are registered in the taxonomy doc; unknown types must degrade to their category.

NodeCategory.description: Closed rendering/query category. Frozen within a schema major version — new source semantics go into the open 'type' field, never here.

Ext.description: The single lossless extension point. Keys are namespaces ('tei', 'x-vendor') or namespace/subject pairs ('src/epub'); values are arbitrary JSON. Servers round-trip ext untouched; clients ignore unknown namespaces.

ValidationState.description: Review lifecycle state of parsed content.

profile.description: Structure profile the parser applied (e.g. 'epub', 'pdf', 'tei'). Matches a per-format alias table in the taxonomy.

Correction.description: One manual or automated correction applied after initial parse. History is append-only.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the corrected field within the entity.

Provenance.description: How this entity came to exist: which parser produced it, when, from what, how confident, and what has been corrected since.

BBox.description: Rectangle on a physical page. Origin top-left of the page.

EntityRef.description: Typed pointer to any Context Fabric entity.
